intents.text:
Rishabh is **Sr. AI Researcher at Simplilearn** in Bengaluru, on-site since March 2026. He leads hands-on research into emerging AI technology and turns it into automation for the business — agentic orchestration, multi-step workflow automation, open-source work, and prototypes of new AI tech as it emerges.

His strongest proof is the [Collaterals Agent](/projects/collaterals-agent), an N8N-based multi-agent system he built that cut course-launch collateral creation from 7–10 days to one day and won Simplilearn's Best Team Award (Q3).

Want his [résumé](/resume) or to get in touch? You can email him at rishabhhota19@gmail.com or use the **Share your details** button below.

intents.text:
Rishabh built an IoT-enabled COVID-19 Decision Support System as a college project with a team of four (Oct 2022 – Apr 2023). It used a two-stage pipeline: stage one assessed vitals and symptoms, stage two added chest X-ray analysis, and a rule-based engine combined everything into a report with recommended next steps. It placed 6th college-wide.

The work fed into his research on multi-modal COVID-19 prediction and chest CT classification, both listed under [Research](/publications). See the full project page here: [COVID-19 Decision Support System](/projects/covid-decision-support).

intents.text: Yes. His AI Portfolio Agent on this site is a LangGraph agent in Python, running on Vercel with FastAPI since October 2026. The graph handles greetings, contact questions and "take me to …" requests without an LLM call, and delegates everything else to a LangGraph supervisor that picks the right tool — RAG, a web search tool, or a Python tool — and returns a final answer.
